suggestions.pitch: Two non-scoring pieces (Allen projects 0, Evans 1.9 a week) for Etienne, who produces 11.3 a week and would start at RB or flex for me.
Allen projects zero, so I swap him for Spears, a similar-value RB who adds 7.7 a week of depth.
Costs only a modest 14.7 projected points while moving backup Geno Smith and the fading Evans for RB help.
